manaNeeded: {0} plus the mana cost of the creature in your hand
easyPrerequisites: All-Fates Stalker must be exiled by Mardu Siegebreaker, and Changeling Hero must begin in hand. (This starting order is not fixed, and their initial positions may be interchanged as necessary.)
description:
Cast Changeling Hero for its mana cost.
When Changeling Hero enters, it exiles Mardu Siegebreaker until Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Changeling Hero's ETB.
When Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield, All-Fates Stalker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When All-Fates Stalker enters, it exiles Changeling Hero until All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of All-Fates Stalker's ETB.
When Changeling Hero leaves the battlefield, Mardu Siegebreaker is returned from exile to the battlefield.
When Mardu Siegebreaker enters, it exiles All-Fates Stalker until Mardu Siegebreaker leaves the battlefield. Resolve any additional effects of Mardu Siegebreaker's ETB.
When All-Fates Stalker leaves the battlefield, Changeling Hero is returned from exile to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 2.
